transcript.text: Thanks, Elena. From a packaging engineering standpoint, I'd recommend assigning all 8 North Site skids to the truck convoy. Here's my reasoning: the North Site skids must remain upright and cannot be stacked under any circumstances, and each one needs two ratchet restraints during loading. Truck transport gives us more direct control over how each skid is loaded, secured, and oriented — we can visually confirm each skid is upright and properly restrained before the truck departs. Rail transport typically involves less hands-on control during loading and transfer, which increases the risk that the no-stacking and upright requirements could be compromised. So my recommendation is: 8 North Site skids go by truck, and the remaining 2 truck slots plus all 10 rail slots carry the 12 South Site skids.
